# Traffic Engine AI — Complete Cloud & Self-Hosted Reference (https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/)

Managed Apify Store Actor: https://apify.com/hirepulse/website-traffic-generator
Actor Title: Website Traffic Generator (Web, E-Commerce, Blogs, GA4 & More!)
Pricing Model: PAY_PER_EVENT ($0.003 per completed visit / $3.00 per 1,000 visits + Actor start)
Open-Source Repository: https://github.com/edtool79-collab/ai-organic-traffic-engine (MIT License)
Interactive Dual JSON Builder: https://edtool79-collab.github.io/ai-organic-traffic-engine/config-builder/

## 1. Managed Cloud Execution (Apify Store: `hirepulse/website-traffic-generator`)
Runs multi-engine synthetic user journeys, load tests, and live Google Analytics 4 (`GA4`) hit verification in Apify Cloud with built-in Apify Proxy or user-supplied proxy URLs.

### Supported Input Schema Fields (`.actor/input_schema.json`)
- `targetUrl` (string): Primary website, e-commerce store, SaaS app, or blog URL.
- `startUrls` (array): Additional URLs visited in round-robin rotation.
- `pages` (array): Internal sub-paths (e.g., `["/", "/pricing", "/blog"]`).
- `visitCount` (integer, 1–50000): Total synthetic visits to run.
- `maxConcurrency` (integer, 1–32): Parallel sessions bounded by container RAM Governor.
- `dwellTimeSecs` (integer, 1–180): Biometric scroll and reading dwell time per page.
- `waveMode` (enum): `natural_peaks`, `steady`, `ramp_up`, `burst`, `off`.
- `aiMode` (enum): `smart_heuristic` (default zero-key autonomous DOM explorer & advisor), `hirepulse` (`gethirepulse.xyz/credits`), `openai`, `gemini`, `openrouter`, `groq`, `ollama_cloud`, or `off`.
- `aiGoal` (string): Plain-English visitor mission guiding autonomous `ai_explore` actions with in-memory `Playbook Cache` (0 repeat LLM tokens).
- `aiRouteRepair` (boolean): Self-healing selector recovery when UI classes/IDs change.
- `aiApiKey` (secret string): Optional encrypted HirePulse Credit Key or BYOK LLM API key.
- `aiModel` (string): Optional custom model override for BYOK providers.
- `executionMode` (enum): `browser_journey` (real browser + JS + GA4) | `http_fast` (protocol load check).
- `browserEngine` (enum): `patchright` (zero CDP leak) | `chromium` (Playwright Stealth) | `camoufox` (Firefox).
- `devicePreset` (enum): `mixed_realistic`, `desktopChrome`, `iphone14`, `pixel7`, `desktopFirefox`, `desktopSafari`, `ipadPro11`.
- `sessionPersistence` (boolean): Reuse `storageState` across visits to simulate returning visitors.
- `referrerMode` (enum): `mixed`, `google_organic`, `search_engines`, `social`, `direct`.
- `searchQuery` (string): Custom organic keyword injected into Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo/Social referrer URLs.
- `utmCampaign` (string): Optional UTM campaign tag.
- `scenarioSteps` (array): Custom journey steps (`goto`, `search_entry`, `human_browse`, `read_article`, `scroll`, `scroll_to`, `click`, `hover`, `fill`, `select`, `press`, `internal_nav`, `scan_products`, `dismiss_overlays`, `wait`, `assert`, `go_back`, `close_tab`, `screenshot`).
- `verifyGa4` (boolean): Captures outgoing `/g/collect`, GTM, Clarity, Plausible, and PostHog beacons (`ga4Verified`, `ga4MeasurementIds`, `ga4Events`, `consoleErrors`).
- `resourceMode` (enum): `ultra_lite` (~80% bandwidth saved while keeping JS & GA4), `lite`, `full`.
- `captureScreenshots` (boolean): Saves viewport PNGs (`VISIT_001.png`...) to Key-Value Store.
- `countryCode` (string): ISO-2 geo country matching browser locale, timezone, and localized search domains.
- `proxyConfiguration` (object): Apify Proxy (`{"useApifyProxy": true}`) or custom proxy URLs.

### Cloud Outputs
1. Default Dataset (`overview` view): Per-visit HTTP status, load latency, device, organic referrer, GA4 verification, JS errors, WAF/challenge status, and route trail.
2. `SUMMARY_REPORT.html` (Key-Value Store): Dark-mode executive QA dashboard with Avg/P50/P95 latency, GA4 pass rate, and bandwidth savings.
3. `OUTPUT` (Key-Value Store): Structured JSON run summary for webhooks, CI/CD, Make, n8n, and MCP agents.

## 2. Self-Hosted Open-Source Studio (`edtool79-collab/ai-organic-traffic-engine`)
Primary Runtime: Node.js LTS (Express dashboard on `127.0.0.1:4310` with live `rrweb` preview) + Docker Compose (`swarm` & `lightpanda` profiles).

### Quickstart Commands
```bash
git clone https://github.com/edtool79-collab/ai-organic-traffic-engine.git
cd ai-organic-traffic-engine
npm install && npm --prefix dashboard install
npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit
cp config.example.json config.json
npm start
```
